blizzard_diffuse.description: Blizzard / WoW-style stylized diffuse (TexTools 'Paint Base'; defaults are the white-grey 'pearl' ramp): a vertical value ramp with a warm sunlit top and a cool ambient bottom, cavity darkening in creases, concave wrinkle creases read off the baked curvature, a top-light lift on upward faces, a clean convex edge highlight, and a painted outline inside the border of each UV island. Diffuse + roughness only: metallic stays 0, height stays neutral so it stays a game-ready albedo. The cavity and crease terms are what a high poly actually buys: bake with bake.normal.high plus bake.normal.curvature 4 and curvature_gain 2.

top.doc: ramp color at the top: lighter, a touch warmer, same hue family as mid

mid.doc: the actual material color, sits at the middle of the ramp

bottom.doc: ramp color at the bottom: darker, cooler, same hue family as mid

low.doc: bbox height (0..1) where the bottom color lands

high.doc: bbox height (0..1) where the top color lands

curve.doc: gamma on the ramp; <1 pushes the light half up the silhouette

cavity.doc: 0..1 strength of the crevice darkening (the AO/cavity term)

cavity_color.doc: color pulled into crevices; keep it cool and in the hue family

cavity_soft.doc: upper end of the cavity window: 0.10 hairline creases, 0.3-0.45 soft fold shadows (a narrow window saturates into flat plateaus)

cavity_blur.doc: blur radius in texels at 1024 applied to the cavity field before the window: kills the baked lattice staircase

crease.doc: 0..1 concave crease darkening; this is the term that pays for a high poly - with only a low poly it has almost nothing to draw (0 to disable)

crease_color.doc: crease color: a cool dark a step above cavity_color, so folds stay readable inside cavity shadow

crease_lo.doc: concave curvature where a crease starts (lower = even shallow wrinkles count; raise on a low-poly bake, whose concave field is sliver noise)

crease_hi.doc: concave curvature where a crease is full; keep the window wide - a narrow one clips to flat plateaus

crease_blur.doc: blur radius in texels at 1024 on the concave field before the window

crease_rough.doc: extra roughness added in creases (0 disables); added, not replaced

edge_color.doc: color of the edge highlight; keep it warm, so it reads on light albedos where a white lift has no contrast

edge_lo.doc: curvature where the edge light starts (raise = only the sharpest ridges)

edge_hi.doc: curvature where the edge light is full

edge_blur.doc: blur radius in texels at 1024; widen thin lines on low-poly meshes

seam.doc: 0..1 outline inside the border of each UV island (0 = off)

seam_color.doc: outline color: a dark in the same hue family, a step under `bottom` so it survives on the light half

seam_width.doc: outline width in texels at 1024 (scales with the set resolution)

seam_soft.doc: 0 = crisp inked line, 1 = soft airbrushed edge

cavity_rough.doc: extra roughness added in crevices (0 disables); added, not replaced - see the blend_modes note on the Cavity layer
